Club aircraft

Meet the fleet.

From first lesson to cross-country adventure, our club-owned aircraft give members a clear path to grow.

TrainersPerformanceSimulatorTowplanes

Eight ways to get airborne

Built for every stage of the journey.

FLSC maintains two-seat trainers, approachable solo ships, high-performance sailplanes, a realistic simulator, and two tow aircraft.

Operating limits are summarized from the club’s published fleet page. Pilots must use current approved aircraft documents and club procedures.

Two-seat trainer · N574

Schleicher ASK 21

Fiberglass mid-wing trainer for all levels of instruction, cross-country flight, aerobatics, and spin training with approved tailweights.

Best glide34:1
Stall37 KIAS
Vne151 KIAS
Final49 KIAS + wind
Operating handbook ↗
Two-seat trainer · N234WE

Schweizer SGS 2-33A

Rugged American primary trainer with docile stall behavior, a low stall speed, short landing capability, and a broad cockpit weight range.

Best glide23:1
Stall33 MPH dual
Vne98 MPH
Final50 MPH + wind
Operating handbook ↗
Standard Class · N20737

Grob G 102 Astir CS

Single-seat fiberglass sailplane with a retractable wheel, good low-speed handling, docile stall characteristics, and aerobatic certification.

Best glide34:1
Stall33 KIAS
Vne135 KIAS
Final51 KIAS + wind
Operating handbook ↗
Standard Class · N70FP

Centrair Pegasus 101B

Carbon-spar competition sailplane with excellent handling, benign stall characteristics, winglets, and a claimed 41:1 maximum glide ratio.

Best glide41:1
Stall39 KIAS
Vne135/119 KIAS
Final49 KIAS
Operating handbook ↗
One-design · N3822A

Schweizer SGS 1-26A

Light, forgiving solo sailplane that climbs well, lands short, and makes an ideal transition after solo and into early cross-country flying.

Best glide23:1
Stall28 MPH
Vne104 MPH
Final45 MPH + wind
Operating handbook ↗
Ground trainer · 1111

Holtz Mach 0.2 Simulator

Condor-powered trainer with realistic controls, feedback, trim, adjustable rudder pedals, spoiler, gear, release, and a wide visual display—the same family used at the USAF Academy.

Tow & utility · N7519F

Champion Citabria 7GCAA

Two-seat conventional-gear aircraft used for spin training, field selection, tow-pilot checkouts, and backup towing of lighter club gliders.

Operating handbook ↗
Primary towplane · N7409Z

Piper PA-25-235 Pawnee

A purposeful former agricultural aircraft converted for glider towing. The Pawnee’s power and visibility have made the type a classic soaring tug.

Operating handbook ↗
